summary: Verified all 4 targets of iteration 35: (1) Entity classifier locale keywords — all 24 unit tests pass, incl. 5 new locale tests (Russian/Chinese/Arabic IPv4, Chinese software_version, Japanese Windows build). HTTP verification via /api/rc5/entities/classify-token: all four locale contexts return the expected kind with confidence 0.95. (2) CorpusHealthPill renders next to wordmark (data-testid=corpus-health-pill, data-gate=pass, 'CORPUS · 88/88'); no runtime errors from the transition-based toasts. (3) Cmd+K palette opens, typing '>' switches to command mode with exactly 8 alias rows; typing '>run bench' filters to a single '>run benchmark' alias; Enter fires a REAL POST /api/rc5/golden/run and a sonner toast 'Benchmark started' is rendered. (4) POST /api/rc5/parse now returns both evidence_graph and correlation populated; correlation.stats has all 5 required keys (node_count, edge_count, temporal_spans, dependency_chains, contradictions). /api/rc5/entities/correlate still works with an EvidenceGraph body (empty graph → ok:true, real /parse graph → ok:true w/ non-zero node/edge counts). CI=true yarn build succeeds. No new console errors on Workspace, Dashboard, Benchmark, Training Inbox (only the pre-existing /api/training-inbox 404 that was already documented in iteration 34).

minor.issue: Login latency currently ~70s under load (backend event loop appears busy servicing a background LiteLLM job — many 'LiteLLM completion() model=claude-sonnet-4-5' log lines every few seconds). Once a token is acquired, all subsequent /api/rc5/* endpoints respond quickly. Not a regression from this iteration — just noting because the pytest suite (test_iter35_verify.py) times out on the login fixture until the background task settles.

action_items: Consider whether the LiteLLM background job that saturates the event loop for ~60-70s at startup can be moved to a worker / offloaded — it blocks login for a full minute on cold cache. Not blocking; but pytest suites will keep timing out until then.

critical_code_review_comments: rc5_diag.py wires the correlation sidecar behind evidence_graph_mode()=='sidecar' AND wraps the correlate() call in try/except that silently sets None — good defensive posture; verdict is never influenced by correlation.
QuickOpenPalette command mode is nicely isolated: buildCommands() memoised on navigate; command-mode filter branch keeps the fuzzy path unchanged; each alias runs a REAL api.get/api.post (no mocks).

CorpusHealthPill uses a useRef for the previous gate so toasts fire only on the flip, not every 60 s poll — correct pattern. Toast ids ('corpus-regression-alert' / 'corpus-recovery-alert') prevent duplicate stacks.
